verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is ingestion: raw data can be pushed via API endpoint or CSV upload for normalization and mapping, and user access data can be pulled in via CSV. A REST API with Lucene search and an MCP server for managing controls, tests, vendors and risks would allow scripted multi-item work, but no native bulk or batch operation is documented. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/update/delete actions across many items, batch API endpoints, bulk operations via the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.
